basis: career fixture builds career.db with synthetic resume, Discovery, fake_analyze, FakePackModel and scripted interview model; closes DB.
application_pack setup builds pack.db and uses FakePackModel; migration test builds old.db with migrations only; closes DB.
Exact temp naming matches pytest _mk_tmp: sanitized request.node.name[:30], numeric suffix. Ambiguous prefixes are held.
Frozen original failure/revision JSON remains in tests/fixtures; only generated successful fixture DB is considered.
regeneration_recipe.proposed_rebuild_command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -X utf8 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_remaining_cover_style.py tests/test_application_pack.py -k "not real" --basetemp=tmp/f3-rebuild-e5-NEW --junitxml=tmp/f3-rebuild-e5-NEW.xml
regeneration_recipe.rebuild_boundary: Semantically regenerated synthetic state, not identical UUID/time/DB bytes. Use a NEW basetemp; never overwrite evidence.
regeneration_recipe.live_excluded: -k not real excludes both opt-in real writer/reviser tests even if live environment variables are set.

limitations: No whole-dataset content hashes: byte sizes/mtimes are metadata snapshots, not verified 5.8GB byte identity.

Directory references protect descendants. Generic/dynamic/partial paths remain review items; no-reference never grants deletion permission.
Regeneration candidate is a review label, not approval. Failure originals, paid data, recovery evidence and images stay protected.
No deletion mode or rebuild execution exists in this tool. F3 cleanup remains incomplete.
